site.bookMessage: Hi! I'd like to book a table at Território.
site.menuLede: Plates to share, raw dishes, ramen, onigiri and the house drinks.
site.menuNoteLanguage: Dish descriptions are still in Portuguese.
site.privacyLede: How Território looks after the data of people who book and visit the site.
site.cookiesText: We use what the site needs to work. With your permission, we also remember your details for the next booking and count how the site is used, without knowing who you are.
site.cookiesNecessaryText: The theme, your cookie choice and the session after the code. Always on.
site.bookBandText: Wednesday to Saturday, from 7 pm. Pick the day and time right here; the confirmation comes on your WhatsApp.
site.cookies_rememberText: Your name, WhatsApp and party size, so the next booking is already filled in. It stays on this device only.
site.cookies_measurementText: Pages visited, where you came from and the booking steps, with no name or phone.
site.cookiesTable: Cookies and data kept on your device
site.cookiesNone: We use no third-party cookies, ads or Google Analytics.
site.quoteBy: Marcus Norberto, on the house's Instagram
site.todayShifts: We are open today in two shifts: {shifts}.
site.langSuggest: Would you rather read the site in English?
site.mapAlt: Map of the streets around the house, with the pin at {address}
site.bookLeaveText: What you've picked stays here if you come back.

notFound.title: This page doesn't exist
notFound.text: The address may have changed or have a typo. Go back to the start or book your table.

site.eventsEmpty: No events coming up right now. The house opens Wednesday to Saturday, and you can book a table right here.

eventMode.mixed: A table inside or the list in the yard

book.noSlots: That day has no time for this group. Pick another day.

after.pending: The house checks and replies on your WhatsApp. Until then, the table is held.

book.keep: Remember my name and WhatsApp on this device for next time.
book.waitsOnTime: Your table is held at {time} sharp
book.bigWhatsappHelp: For more than {max} people, the house puts tables together with you on WhatsApp.
book.bigRequestHelp: A large group is a request: the house checks the tables and answers on your WhatsApp.
book.bigLead: For {n} people, the house sets up the table with you. If you like, add your name, the day and the time: the message is ready to send.
book.bigAfter: The house answers there and sets up the table with you.
book.askedDayClosed: {day}: the house is closed ({reason}). We picked the next day with tables.
book.notesOver: Over the limit: {count}/{max}. Shorten it a little; nothing was cut.
book.sameNightKept: All good: no new booking was made. To change the one you have, use My bookings.
book.outsideWindow: That day is outside the booking window. Pick one of the days on the calendar.
book.zoneDays: Days and times in Foz do Iguaçu time.
book.freeEntryText: {event} is free entry: no booking needed, just come.
book.freeEntryPlain: No booking needed that day: just come.
book.dayClosed: The house is closed that day: {reason}.

eventMode.tables: Event night: tables are booked as usual.
eventMode.list: Event night with a list: you book your spot, no table to choose ({n} spots).
eventMode.mixed: Event night: choose a table or a spot on the list, each with its own limit.

book.dietaryNotice: A dietary restriction is health data. Only the people serving your table see it, and we erase it 30 days after the visit.
book.dietaryPrivacy: How we look after your data
book.codeSentTo: We sent a 6-digit code to WhatsApp {phone}. It is good for 10 minutes and 5 tries.

receipt.missing: We couldn't find that booking. Check the link in the message or make a new one.
receipt.closed: This booking is no longer active.

receipt.lateNoteRelease: If you arrive after {ate}, the table may be given away.
receipt.lateNoteExtra: Running late? Let us know and the table waits until {extra}.
receipt.lateDone: Got it. The table waits for you until {ate}.
receipt.cancelLate: It's less than {prazo} hours before your booking: you can cancel, but it's recorded as last-minute.
receipt.cancelOnlyHouse: The deadline to cancel here has passed. Message the house on WhatsApp.

receipt.codeHelp: Use the code {code} if you talk to the house.
receipt.inApp: Inside Instagram the calendar file often won't download. Open it in the browser or copy the link.
receipt.copyFailed: Couldn't copy here. Press and hold the receipt link to copy it.

signin.title: Sign in with WhatsApp
signin.lead: No password: we send a 6-digit code to your WhatsApp and you sign in to see, change and cancel your bookings.
signin.phoneLead: That is where the house confirms and updates your booking. The code arrives there.
signin.phoneHelp: Numbers from Brazil, Paraguay and Argentina.
signin.sample: here the site would go to Google and come back. Choose how it comes back:

mine.freeUntilDay: Cancel free of charge until {day}, at {time}
mine.deadlinePassed: The cancel deadline has passed: if you can't come, let the house know anyway.
mine.cancelLate: The deadline has passed: you can cancel, no fee, but it counts as last minute.
mine.canceled: Booking {code} canceled. The table is free for someone else.
mine.canceledLate: Canceled. As the deadline had passed, it counted as last minute, no fee.
mine.leaveText: You leave the queue for that time and your place goes to the next person.
mine.changed: Done: booking {code} is now {when}. The new confirmation goes to your WhatsApp.
mine.offerUntil: Table offered: answer by {time} through the message.
mine.waCancel: Hi! I need to cancel booking {code}.
mine.waChange: Hi! I'd like to change booking {code} to {n} people.

data.title: My data
data.name: Name
data.emailHelp: Only for a copy of the receipt and, if you want, the news.
data.newsLabel: I want to get the house's news
data.newsHelp: Separate from the booking: you can untick it any time.
data.phoneChanged: Number changed: {phone}. Your bookings stay yours and the next messages go there.
data.yoursLead: Download everything the house keeps about you, or ask for it to be erased.
data.downloaded: Done: two files, one to keep (JSON) and one to read.
data.waData: Hi! I'd like a copy of my data.
data.forgetText: The house erases your name, phone and email within 15 days and tells you on WhatsApp before erasing the number.
data.forgetBookings: Your {n} coming bookings will be canceled now.
data.forgetQueue: You also leave the waitlist, and an offered table goes to the next person.
data.forgottenText: The house erases your data by {day}. The confirmation reaches your WhatsApp before the number is erased.

link.question: Are you coming?
link.canChange: You can change it until the time.
link.doneYes: Thanks! The house knows you're coming.
link.doneLate: Noted. The table waits a little longer, as shown below.
link.doneNo: Booking canceled. Thanks for letting us know: the table goes to someone else.
link.past: This booking's time has passed. For something new, make another booking.

closed.declined: The house couldn't take this booking. Message on WhatsApp and we'll find another time.

wait.until: Answer by {time}. After that, the table goes to the next person.
wait.declineText: The table goes to the next person and you leave the queue for this time.
wait.declined: All set: the turn went to the next person.
wait.accepted: The table is yours! The confirmation goes to your WhatsApp.
wait.swapTitle: Swap your {time} booking for this one?
wait.swapText: You already have booking {code} that night (or reached the limit). Swapping keeps the same code with this table.
wait.swapped: Swapped: booking {code} is now at this table.
wait.nightOver: The waitlist for this time is over: the turn has closed.
wait.out: You left the queue for this time.

network.title: No connection
network.text: The internet dropped along the way. Check your connection and try again. What you typed is still here.

timeout.title: The house took too long to answer
timeout.text: It may be the internet or a busy moment. Try again in a moment: nothing gets doubled.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.text: As soon as the connection is back, the page picks up where it left off.

server.title: Something went wrong on our side
server.text: It wasn't anything you did. Try again in a moment or message the house on WhatsApp.

bad_response.title: The answer came back incomplete
bad_response.text: Try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, message the house on WhatsApp.

bad_request.title: We couldn't read that request
bad_request.text: Reload the page and try again. If it keeps happening, message the house on WhatsApp.

unknown.title: Something didn't go as planned
unknown.text: Try again. If it keeps happening, message the house on WhatsApp.

screen_error.title: Something went wrong on this screen
screen_error.text: Reload the page. Anything already saved is still saved.

static_mode.title: For now, bookings are on WhatsApp
static_mode.text: Booking here isn't switched on yet. Message the house on WhatsApp and we'll save you a table.

no_script.title: JavaScript needs to be on
no_script.text: To book here, your browser needs JavaScript. Or message the house on WhatsApp.

storage_blocked.title: This browser isn't saving anything
storage_blocked.text: You can book as usual, we just won't remember your details next time.

cookies_blocked.title: Your browser is blocking cookies
cookies_blocked.text: Without them we can't keep you signed in. Allow cookies for this site and try again, or message the house on WhatsApp.

turnstile_failed.title: We need to check again
turnstile_failed.text: The robot check didn't go through. Tap try again; if it repeats, reload the page or message the house on WhatsApp.

rate_limited.title: Too many tries in a row
rate_limited.text: To keep the house safe, we paused for a bit. Try again in {minutes} min.

otp.title: We've sent too many codes
otp.text: Wait {minutes} min to ask for another, or sign in with Google. In a hurry? Message the house on WhatsApp.

otp_house.title: We can't send more codes today
otp_house.text: Message the house on WhatsApp and we'll book you in there.

csrf_failed.title: We need to reload the page
csrf_failed.text: The page was open for a long time. Reload and do it again; anything already saved is still there.

validation.title: A few fields need fixing
validation.text: Check the marked fields and tap continue again.

honeypot.title: That didn't go through
honeypot.text: Reload the page and try again, or message the house on WhatsApp.

otp.title: That code doesn't match
otp.text: Check the 6 digits we sent on WhatsApp. {left} tries left.

idempotency.title: This was already sent
idempotency.text: Reload the page and check how it turned out before sending again.

unauthorized.title: Sign in to continue
unauthorized.text: Get a code on WhatsApp or sign in with Google.

session_expired.title: You've been signed out
session_expired.text: It's been a while. Get a code on WhatsApp or sign in with Google.

session_expired_draft.title: We need the code again
session_expired_draft.text: Your details and chosen time are still here. Confirm the code we send on WhatsApp and the booking goes on.

otp.title: The code expired
otp.text: It lasts 10 minutes and 5 tries. Ask for a new one; what you filled in is still here.

link.title: This link has expired
link.text: Links last up to 30 days after the booking. For something new, make another booking or message the house on WhatsApp.

otp_resend_wait.title: You can ask again in a moment
otp_resend_wait.text: Send again in {seconds} s. WhatsApp sometimes takes a little while.

otp_not_arrived.title: Didn't get the code?
otp_not_arrived.text: Check the number and ask again. You can also sign in with Google or message the house on WhatsApp.

google_failed.title: Google sign-in didn't work
google_failed.text: Try again or get a code on WhatsApp.

google_needs_phone.title: We just need your WhatsApp
google_needs_phone.text: That's how the house confirms and updates your booking. Confirm your number with the code.

google_in_app_browser.title: To sign in with Google, open this in your browser
google_in_app_browser.text: Instagram doesn't allow Google sign-in here. Tap the three dots and choose open in browser, or get the code on WhatsApp.

phone_country_unsupported.title: Online booking takes numbers from Brazil, Paraguay and Argentina
phone_country_unsupported.text: With a number from another country, message the house on WhatsApp and we'll book your table there. What you filled in is still here.

customer_blocked.title: Let's sort this out on WhatsApp
customer_blocked.text: For this request, the house would rather talk to you directly. Message us on WhatsApp and we'll sort it out.

slot_full.title: That time just filled up
slot_full.text: Someone confirmed first. Your details are still here: pick another time or join the waitlist.

cutoff.title: That time is closed for online booking
cutoff.text: It got too close to arrival time. Your details are still here: pick another time or message the house on WhatsApp.

day_closed.title: The house closed that day
day_closed.text: {reason} Your details are still here: pick another day or message the house on WhatsApp.

event_mode.title: That day is now an event night
event_mode.text: The house published an event that day and booking now follows its way. Your details are still here: look at the day again or pick another.

waitlist_full.title: The waitlist for that time is full
waitlist_full.text: Your details are still here: pick another time or message the house on WhatsApp.

day_full.title: That day is full
day_full.text: See the next days with a table for your group just below.

window_full.title: Every open day is full
window_full.text: Message the house on WhatsApp or Instagram: sometimes a table opens up last minute.

same_day_reservation.title: You already have a booking that day, at {time}
same_day_reservation.text: Want to make another one? If you just want a different time, it's better to change the one you have.

duplicate_reservation.title: You already have a booking at that time
duplicate_reservation.text: It's saved in My bookings. To change people or time, do it there.

active_limit.title: You already have {max} bookings
active_limit.text: That's the limit per number. Change or cancel one in My bookings, or message the house on WhatsApp.

terms_outdated.title: The house rules changed
terms_outdated.text: The house updated its rules while you were filling in. Read them again and tick "Read and agreed" to go on. Your details are still here.

party_too_large.title: We set up big groups with you
party_too_large.text: For more than {max} people, the house puts tables together with you on WhatsApp.

invalid_transition.title: This booking has already changed
invalid_transition.text: It's no longer active or was updated. See how it stands now; if needed, message the house on WhatsApp.

late.title: The table is no longer held
late.text: The time your table was held for you has passed. You can still sit if there's room: message the house on WhatsApp.

late_off.title: To say you're running late, talk to the house
late_off.text: This notice doesn't apply to this booking. Message us on WhatsApp and we'll work it out.

outside_cancel_window.title: It's too late to cancel here
outside_cancel_window.text: Message the house on WhatsApp and we'll sort it out.

reschedule.title: This booking can't be changed here
reschedule.text: Either it's past the deadline or the house prefers to arrange it directly. Message us on WhatsApp.

link_used.title: That's already done
link_used.text: This button was already used and the booking is up to date. See how it looks now.

not_found.title: We couldn't find that booking
not_found.text: Check the link in the message or make a new one.

page.title: This page doesn't exist
page.text: It may have moved. Go back home or make a booking.

link.title: This link didn't open
link.text: It may have been cut off when copied. Open it again straight from the WhatsApp message, or message the house there.

receipt_render_failed.title: Your booking is done
receipt_render_failed.text: The receipt didn't open here, but the confirmation is on its way to your WhatsApp. It's also in My bookings.

read_only_link.title: This link is view-only
read_only_link.text: To change the booking, use the button in the confirmation message or go to My bookings.

offer_expired.title: The time to accept has passed
offer_expired.text: The {minutes} minutes ran out and the table went to the next person. You're back at the end of the list for this time, and we'll let you know again if a table opens up. Or pick another time, or message the house on WhatsApp.

phone_in_use.title: That number belongs to another account
phone_in_use.text: Sign in with it using the WhatsApp code, or message the house to merge the two accounts.

download_failed.title: The file didn't download
download_failed.text: Try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, ask on WhatsApp and the house will send it.
